mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdCurrOrderProd ( OrderNo, OrderProdNo, ProdQty, SalePrice, SupplyPrice, ChnlName, PrevProdName, PrevItemName, EventName, ProdName, PriceGiftQty, ItemGiftQty, BundleYn, Keywrd, Capa, TotalQty, MatchProdCode, BuyPrice, TotalBuyPrice, MatchProdSect, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{orderProdNo}, #{prodQty}, #{salePrice}, #{supplyPrice}, #{chnlName}, #{prevProdName}, #{prevItemName}, #{eventName}, #{prodName}, #{priceGiftQty}, #{itemGiftQty}, #{bundleYn}, #{keywrd}, #{capa}, #{totalQty}, #{matchProdCode}, #{buyPrice}, #{totalBuyPrice}, #{matchProdSect}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdCurrOrderProd ( OrderNo, OrderProdNo, ProdQty, SalePrice, SupplyPrice, ChnlName, PrevProdName, PrevItemName, EventName, ProdName, ItemName, BundleYn, Keywrd, Capa, TotalQty, MatchProdCode, BuyPrice, TotalBuyPrice, MatchProdSect, State, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate) SELECT O.OrderNo, UD.OrderSeq, O.ProdQty, O.SalePrice, O.SupplyPrice, O.ChnlName, O.PrevProdName, O.ItemName, UH.EventName, O.ProdName, CASE WHEN UD.OrderSeq = 1 THEN UH.ItemName ELSE '' END, O.BundleYn, UD.Keywrd, UD.Capa, UD.Qty AS TotalQty, UD.MatchUpriceCode, U.Uprice, (UD.Qty * U.Uprice) AS TotalBuyPrice, CONCAT(UD.Keywrd, '-', UD.Capa, '-', UD.Qty) AS MatchProdSect, 1, 'RegistId', 'RegistName', NOW() FROM shopwizard.tOrdOrderWork O INNER JOIN shopwizard.tOrdOrderUpriceMatch UH ON UH.ProdName = O.ProdName AND UH.ChnlName = O.ChnlName AND UH.EventName = O.EventName INNER JOIN shopwizard.tOrdOrderUpriceOptionMatch UD ON UH.OrderNo = UD.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tOrdOrderUprice U ON U.MatchUpriceCode = UD.MatchUpriceCode WHERE U.UseYn = 1 AND O.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND O.ProdName = #{prodName} AND O.ChnlName = #{chnlName} AND O.EventName = #{eventName}
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOrdCurrOrderProd SET OrderNo = #{orderNo}, OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo}, ProdQty = #{prodQty}, SalePrice = #{salePrice}, SupplyPrice = #{supplyPrice}, ChnlName = #{chnlName}, PrevProdName = #{prevProdName}, PrevItemName = #{prevItemName}, EventName = #{eventName}, ProdName = #{prodName}, PriceGiftQty = #{priceGiftQty}, ItemGiftQty = #{itemGiftQty}, BundleYn = #{bundleYn}, Keywrd = #{keywrd}, Capa = #{capa}, TotalQty = #{totalQty}, MatchProdCode = #{matchProdCode}, BuyPrice = #{buyPrice}, TotalBuyPrice = #{totalBuyPrice}, MatchProdSect = #{matchProdSect}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW()
